method: Headless Chromium from this research environment, 1280 by 900 window, locale en-CA, no consent banner answered, nothing clicked or submitted; full screenshots kept privately, only the crops below are published.
note: Fresh captures for the Website Messaging examples (founder brief, 31 October 2026). They are dated separately from the 23 October observations and change no observation, status or finding.
